خواندن سهم اکانت‌ها روی ساعت: Read account usage on a timer
سهم هر اکانت Claude هر ۱۵ دقیقه بدون مصر: Each Claude account's usage is read from the service every 15 minutes without spending tokens. Off: usage comes only from the account's own runs — spreading chats still works, but Griffin asks the accounts nothing on a clock. The per-account refresh button always works by hand.
باز کردن صفحهٔ موتورها یک پیام واقعی کوت: Opening the Engines page sends each account one short real message to check its health. Off: the page only shows the account's own recorded state, and the test button does the real check by hand.
پرسیدن شناسهٔ سازمان اکانت: Look up the account's organization id
شناسهٔ سازمان هر اکانت با یک درخواست خام: Each account's organization id is read with one raw request to Anthropic. Off: the organization shows only if the account's own run reported it.
تنظیم زبان «Persian» در هر اجرای Claude: The language setting «Persian» is sent on every Claude Code run; it is what guarantees every chat answers in Persian. Off: Persian comes from the rules text and the request looks like a plain client, but some answers may come back in English.
اجازهٔ فرستادن آمار مصرف و گزارش خطای خو: Allows Claude Code to send its own usage statistics and error reports to Anthropic. Turning it off loses no capability.
دفترچهٔ قواعد و دانش گریفین به سیستم‌پرا: Griffin's rulebook and knowledge are appended to every run's system prompt. Off: the same rules are read the standard Claude Code way (the project file) and the request looks like a plain client's.
چند اجرا روی یک اکانت اشتراکی Claude هم‌: How many runs may sit on one shared Claude account at once. Past this a new chat lands on another account, so one account's share is not burned in one go.
